metadata.segment_boundary_correction: The validation end was moved from 2020-12-29 to 2020-12-17 after the first audit reported only 245 embargo sessions, but before any candidate cache, RankIC, correlation, or strategy return was produced. The 252-session formula, direction, and thresholds were unchanged.
metadata.selection_rule: the sole candidate must have positive mean daily RankIC on the frozen 252-session label, at least 0.50 coverage, and absolute rank correlation below 0.70 versus Alpha158_20 and all frozen v1.7/v1.8/v1.9/v2.0 candidates
metadata.formula_policy: BaoStock query_growth_data.YOYAsset is (current total assets - prior-year total assets) / abs(prior-year total assets). The investable score is its negative, so lower annual asset growth has a higher score.
metadata.availability_policy: Use only quarter-4 reports published no later than June 30 of the following calendar year. A value becomes usable on the first provider trading session strictly after that June 30 formation cutoff, never on statDate or the earlier pubDate.
metadata.staleness_policy: A value becomes missing after 18 calendar months from statDate, yielding the paper-aligned July-to-June annual holding window and preventing indefinite carry-forward.
metadata.missing_policy: Missing or non-finite YOYAsset, invalid dates, pubDate before statDate, publication after the following June 30 formation cutoff, a non-December report, or conflicting duplicate reports fail closed to missing or a failed sync; no interpolation is allowed.
metadata.holding_policy: Use the paper-supported annual I/A formation and holding horizon: form after June 30, trade from the first July session, and hold for 252 trading sessions. Do not alter the formation date, label, or hold threshold after viewing results.
metadata.paper_mapping_policy: The paper defines I/A as annual total assets divided by prior-year total assets minus one. BaoStock YOYAsset is the same ratio because total assets are nonnegative; this implementation negates it so a higher factor score represents conservative investment.
metadata.paper_factor_difference: The cited China study uses Mainboard breakpoints and value-weighted quintile portfolios formed annually. This implementation uses the point-in-time CSI300 universe, cross-sectional rank normalization, and the software's frozen TopkDropout model and execution contract.
metadata.revision_policy: BaoStock exposes the current historical snapshot and no revision vintages. The candidate remains RESEARCH_ONLY even if historical gates pass.

aacce6286aeb85e5.factor_description: Negative point-in-time annual total-asset growth from BaoStock, so conservative investment has the higher score.
aacce6286aeb85e5.factor_formulation: score = -query_growth_data.YOYAsset for quarter 4 published by the following June 30; first-July-session availability; 18-month staleness; 252-session prediction and holding horizon

metadata.hypothesis: Within the point-in-time CSI300 universe, firms with lower annual total-asset growth earn higher subsequent 252-session returns than firms with aggressive asset growth.

feedback.reason: Registered after reviewing primary-source definitions and source-only schema/coverage, but before deriving the factor panel or reading its forward label, RankIC, model contribution, or strategy return.
